R01.prompt:
Use case: product-mockup. Create ONE square 2048x2048 premium commercial PRODUCT PHOTOGRAPH, no typography.
INPUT PRIORITY AND ROLES: images 1-3 are the actual SILVER showerhead and are the authoritative product appearance: 1 front including face/control details, 2 and 3 the two sides. Image 4 is a gray auxiliary side model ONLY to understand the broad continuous head-neck-handle curvature, not a material/design reference; whenever it differs, the actual silver photos win. Image 5 is A038, a DIFFERENT PRODUCT, only a reference for simple white-background complete-item photography and framing. Do NOT copy image5's white face, transparent handle, filter tube, connector design, hole layout, or shape.
Photograph the exact silver showerhead from images1-3 alone on a seamless pure white / very pale gray studio background. Three-quarter FRONT angle, close enough to front that the real black spray face and both controls are readable, with the cylindrical thickness of the right head edge visible. Whole item from top to short bare bottom thread, no crop; about75% of frame height, centered with generous clear space. Subtle grounded soft shadow, clean studio strip reflections. True bright MIRROR SILVER appearance from the real photographs, crisp dark and bright reflections of a real curved reflective surface; not matte gray, not clay, not generic CG steel.
Preserve the actual wide circular head, its narrow silver front rim, a recognizable constant-thickness cylindrical edge then shallow curved rear shell, and the long continuous flowing transition into the handle. The upper handle/head-root curves more, lower handle curves gently. Preserve the real head-to-handle size and length proportions. No straight racket handle glued to a disk, no abrupt shoulder, no goose-neck or exaggerated S bend.
Exact recognizable front details from photo1: textured black face; the actual dense arrangement of small off-white nozzle rings, actual concentric dark micro-hole border; preserve source arrangement rather than inventing a simplified or random grid. Small original RED central descaling press control has a broad low red circular flange and raised smaller concentric boss with dark central opening exactly as photographed; do not replace with a swollen red toy doughnut, enlarge it, or add a black pedestal. Separate lower shiny SILVER rounded-rectangle selector button within the black teardrop front insert, positioned and sized as photographed.
Remove the photographed hand and bathroom. Remove hose and quick-release adapter attached below the original handle. Retain the complete original handle and finish it with only a SHORT BARE SILVER male thread (silver color user-confirmed), not a long adapter, transparent cartridge, or black connector.
No person, hands, model, water or spray, hoses, holder, accessories, rocks, decorative props, logos, brand, text, labels, certificates, diagrams, or dimensions. Dry product. Favor faithful real photographed object over stylization.
